documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Two parties share confidential information (e.g. to evaluate a deal) and each protects the other's information.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: A provider gives a customer access to a SaaS / cloud product.

keyTerms.label: Order Date
keyTerms.description: Date of the first Order Form, if different from the Effective Date

keyTerms.label: Subscription Period
keyTerms.description: Length of each subscription term, e.g. 1 year

keyTerms.label: Fees
keyTerms.description: Subscription fees and payment terms

keyTerms.label: Technical Support
keyTerms.description: Support the provider offers

keyTerms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
keyTerms.description: How far ahead a party must give notice to stop auto-renewal

keyTerms.label: General Cap Amount
keyTerms.description: Limit on each party's total liability

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

keyTerms.label: Target Uptime
keyTerms.description: e.g. 99.9% per month

keyTerms.label: Uptime Credit
keyTerms.description: Credit when uptime falls below target

keyTerms.label: Target Response Time
keyTerms.description: e.g. 4 business hours

keyTerms.label: Response Time Credit
keyTerms.description: Credit when responses are late

keyTerms.label: Support Channel
keyTerms.description: Where support requests are sent

keyTerms.label: Scheduled Downtime
keyTerms.description: Planned maintenance windows

keyTerms.label: Subscription Period
keyTerms.description: Subscription term the SLA applies to

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: A provider processes personal data on a customer's behalf (GDPR processor terms).

keyTerms.label: Agreement
keyTerms.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements

keyTerms.label: Special Category Data
keyTerms.description: Sensitive data, if any, and its safeguards

keyTerms.label: Governing Member State
keyTerms.description: EU member state whose law governs

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: An early partner gets product access in exchange for feedback.

keyTerms.label: Program
keyTerms.description: The design partner program and what the partner gets access to

keyTerms.label: Term
keyTerms.description: How long the agreement lasts

keyTerms.label: Fees
keyTerms.description: Fees, if any

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: A provider delivers services and deliverables under Statements of Work.

keyTerms.label: Deliverables
keyTerms.description: What the provider will deliver (first SOW)

keyTerms.label: Fees
keyTerms.description: Fees for the services

keyTerms.label: Payment Period
keyTerms.description: Days to pay an invoice

keyTerms.label: SOW Term
keyTerms.description: How long the SOW lasts

keyTerms.label: General Cap Amount
keyTerms.description: Limit on each party's total liability

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Two businesses partner, each performing agreed obligations.

keyTerms.label: Obligations
keyTerms.description: What each party will do

keyTerms.label: General Cap Amount
keyTerms.description: Limit on each party's total liability

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: HIPAA terms for a provider that handles protected health information (PHI).

keyTerms.label: Agreement
keyTerms.description: The main agreement this BAA supplements

keyTerms.label: Breach Notification Period
keyTerms.description: e.g. 30 days

keyTerms.label: Limitations
keyTerms.description: Limits on use or disclosure of PHI, if any

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: A customer licenses on-premise software to install and use.

keyTerms.label: License Limits
keyTerms.description: e.g. number of users or installations

keyTerms.label: General Cap Amount
keyTerms.description: Limit on each party's total liability

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: A customer evaluates a product during a limited pilot period.

keyTerms.label: Pilot Period
keyTerms.description: e.g. 90 days

keyTerms.label: Fees
keyTerms.description: Pilot fees, if any

keyTerms.label: General Cap Amount
keyTerms.description: Limit on each party's total liability

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Adds AI terms (inputs, outputs, model training) to an existing agreement.

keyTerms.label: Agreement
keyTerms.description: The main agreement this addendum supplements

keyTerms.label: Training Data
keyTerms.description: Customer data the provider may use for training, if any
